claimLevel: Internal exploratory model-development review, no physical or grid/domain validation

method.geometry: Reconstruct occupancy cumulatively from exact seed plus recorded attached-site coordinates; check all event counts, largest extents and Cartesian aspect ratios exactly. Inclusive axial and Cartesian lateral spans differ from center spans.
method.time: Reuse bracketCavityTime: at-or-before discrete state plus next event, never interpolation or cycle-index matching.
method.quartets: Order both, neither, basal-only, prism-only. Interaction = both - basal-only - prism-only + neither. Common quartet age uses shortest terminal; pair age additionally retained.
method.histories: Each comparison retains actual event time; post-event alignment uses shortest elapsed-after-event in the three switch-stage rows. Static comparisons are common absolute age and unequal initial history, not matched geometry.
method.spatial: All saved pre-update snapshots, means over actual facet cells. Mean cellwise coefficient*boundary supersaturation is a kinetic demand factor, not mass or deposited fill.

sourceCompatibility.scope: Inspected diff contains publication-only retry and finite batch dispatch; numerical core/solver and discovery evolution producer unchanged; same Node runtime.
